confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel anchors vary more with July demand and are less certain. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from RBA figures shown in search results; I did not open the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized southern European capitals with similar summer tourism demand and price levels, such as Lisbon and Rome, adjusted for Athens's generally lower restaurant and café prices.
